test_parallel_sim_finger_instances: test two SimFinger instances run independently without interfering with each other
test_sim_finger_step_one: test stepping one SimFinger instance while verifying the other remains stationary
test_sim_finger_step_both: test two SimFinger instances moving to different target positions simultaneously
create_sim_finger_action: create a SimFinger Action with torque or position values for the robot
run_sim_finger_observation_loop: run a loop that appends actions and retrieves observations from SimFinger instances
